content:
maria_dev: Hey team — hitting a weird failure in SDK v0.9.3 when using `json_mode` + function/tool calling. Model returns a valid JSON object but the SDK validation throws 'structured_output_validation_failed' because of an unexpected top-level key. Repro below. Anyone seen this?

sam_sre: can you paste the exact error and the schema you passed?

maria_dev: Error: `SDKError: structured_output_validation_failed: extra key 'meta' at path / - allowed: ['result']`
Schema: `{"type":"object","properties":{"result":{"type":"object"}},"required":["result"],"additionalProperties":false}`
Model output (stringified): `{"result":{"items":[1,2]},"meta":{"version":"1.0"}}`

olivia_pd: ah — model adding telemetry/meta is common. Previously SDK had a lenient path in our hosted API layer that strips unknown keys before validating, but I think the SDK validator is strict by default. That mismatch causes parity problems for users migrating from hosted -> SDK.

juan_pm: is this causing customer-facing errors or just internal tests?

maria_dev: customer report + CI flakes on our sample app. Also noticed that if the server returns a 401 mid-call (token refresh) the SDK will retry the entire request which can lead to duplicate function invocations when a tool call side-effects (bad). So two things: (1) strict schema validation fails on benign extra keys, (2) retry behavior replays tool calls.

ben_repro: I reproduced locally. Minimal repro: call `client.chat.completions.create({json_mode:true, functions:[...schema...], ...})` against a model that returns the JSON above. SDK throws. Stack snippet: `at validateStructuredOutput (/opt/workspace/node_modules/redwood-sdk/lib/validate.js:87)`

sdk-bot: CI: build 0.9.3 failed on devex/sample-app (test 12) — failing due to structured output validation.

sam_sre: For the retry issue — we should mark function/tool calls as non-idempotent by default and avoid automatic retry on auth refresh, or at least provide an opt-in idempotency key that the runtime can use to dedupe. We already do something similar for uploads.

olivia_pd: Proposed short-term fixes: 1) add an SDK option `validationMode: 'lenient' | 'strict'` default to lenient to preserve parity with hosted. 2) add `allowAdditionalProperties: true` flag for schemas. 3) change auth refresh behavior: do not auto-retry requests that include `function_call` or `tool_call` unless `idempotencyKey` present.

juan_pm: Product note — if we default to lenient, we must warn in docs and add a lint rule in the sample app to toggle strict for CI.

maria_dev: Implementation notes: in node sdk validate.js add a try/catch around `ajv.validate` and if `validationMode==='lenient'` then log a telemetry event and return parsed object (maybe strip unknown keys by default?). Also add a `SDKClient` constructor option so we can toggle without breaking changes.

ben_repro: I can open the PR for the validator change and update the sample app. Will add unit tests for: (a) extra keys tolerated, (b) strict mode still rejects, (c) telemetry emitted when lenient path used.

sam_sre: For retry changes I'll draft a small change to the http middleware: when auth refresh occurs, if request.meta && request.meta.tool_call === true and no idempotencyKey => do not retry, return 401 to caller with a suggested wrapper `wrapNonIdempotentCall`.

olivia_pd: Also add a snippet to quickstart: how to set `client = new RedwoodSDK({validationMode:'lenient', idempotencyKey:'...'});` and call `client.wrapToolCall(fn)` for side-effectful tools. This will help onboarding friction.

maria_dev: Customer-facing patch: release 0.9.4 with lenient default + opt-in strict. Then 0.10.0 will flip default to strict and provide a migration guide.

juan_pm: timeline?

ben_repro: I'll PR today for validator + sample app bump, add tests. sam — can you PR the retry middleware change? I'll coordinate. Hoping to cut 0.9.4 by EOD Friday if both land.

sam_sre: yep will send middleware PR this morning. I'll add an integration test that simulates 401 during a function call and ensures no retry without idempotency key.

olivia_pd: I'll update the quickstart and the migration notes in docs, and add a short blurb in the console release notes to warn about future default flip.

maria_dev: Thanks — can we also add a small e2e sample app that demonstrates `json_mode` tolerant parsing and `wrapToolCall` idempotency pattern? This would reduce onboarding friction if customers can copy the pattern.

ben_repro: yup sample-app will include `examples/json-mode-tolerant` and `examples/tool-idempotency`.

sdk-bot: NOTE: I'll queue a canary deploy for the docs site once PRs merge.

juan_pm: Great. Minor follow-up — please add a changelog entry explaining the telemetry we emit so customers know it's not PII.

maria_dev: Will do. Thanks everyone. I'll paste the PR links here when ready.

ben_repro: PRs: #4384 (validator lenient mode), #4385 (sample app), sam PR will be #4386 (retry middleware).

maria_dev: 👍 I'll test the canary once merged.
